posts.text: Sure, Trump ranting that Iran has to “open the Fuckin’ Strait” is unhinged. But it mainly reminded me of a frustrated, spoiled child. He just doesn’t know what to do, so he’s screaming into the abyss and hoping someone rescues him from the mess he created.

Do the Lebanese have a right to defend themselves? Do the Palestinians? Or if they don’t submit to their own deaths, are they antisemites? Btw, our media actually believes this. If other people don’t submit to Israel taking their homes, they call them terrorists and antisemites.

Over 90% of our politicians are on Israel's side, not ours. They funnel as much of our money to them as they can. They make us fight their wars. Then our national media attacks any American who objects. They label them antisemties and try to ruin their lives so no one can object.

Almost any foreign country would want to do this, if they could. Who doesn't want a free $330 billion? Why would you fight your own wars if you could get best military on earth to do it instead? For free! But when Israel does this, our press pretends they can't understand it.

You're either for Israel or for America. They're not an ally. They're a foreign country bleeding us dry. They've taken hundreds of billions from us, they've driven us into disastrous wars, including this one. They want to use our military and treasure until we have nothing left.

Everyone in legacy media, including @MeetThePress, are fundamentally dishonest. They never ask this question of anyone who talks to @marklevinshow, who is a proud racist and bigot. They think being bigoted against Muslims is great, but any criticism of Israel is unacceptable.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

Khanna on Hasan Piker: "What should the standard of the Democrats be? Should we not go on Joe Rogan? Should we just have purity tests of canceling folks? The lesson of the last election is we've go

Biggest terrorists in the world. They’re using the Iran War as cover for their invasion of Lebanon. Our troops are used as distraction. American media has zero criticism of the new ethnic cleansing they’re doing in southern Lebanon. It’s insane that we’re funding the terrorists.


sarah (@sahouraxo)

BREAKING.

Israel is blowing up entire civilian homes in Naqoura, South Lebanon right now.

Civilian homes.

No military target. 

No justification.

Just pure terror and destruction.

This is a war

They only try to cancel anyone AGAINST A GENOCIDE, while pretending to be the moral ones. I think people in national media are the most immoral people in the country. They support vicious bigotry against Muslims, while pretending to be morally outraged about bigotry. Hypocrites!

Have you ever seen mainstream media cancel anyone for being in favor of Israel’s genocide? Isn’t being pro-genocide the most toxic thing you could be? That means you’re so racist, you don’t mind killing people based on their race or religion. Yet, media never cancels over that.

This idea that you - or others - can’t talk to anyone who you feel is out of bounds is anti-intellectual. It’s an effort to curtail acceptable opinions. It’s not what good or smart people do. It’s what propagandists do to limit conversation to only ideas they’ve pre-approved.

I don’t agree with a lot of what @hasanthehun says. I even have four hour debates with him. So what if we agree on some things and disagree on others? Why do these establishment assholes think they can tell us who we can talk to? I’ll talk to Hasan or anyone else I like. #SuckIt

The same lies by the same people. The only ones who wanted this war all work for Israel. Pete Hegseth told us that we had complete control over Iran’s airspace. What happened now? It’s one thing when you lie about how great Trump is, it’s another when your lies get people killed.
Iran shot down a U.S. fighter jet. Remember when we were promised how easy this would be.

Every problem in the Middle East and every war we’ve fought in the past 60 years are all about one thing - the occupation. It’s the cancer that’s causing all these problems. 

People are never going to accept the Israelis brutally occupying the Palestinians forever. And the Israelis are never going to let them go because they’re vicious. 

They don’t want peace, they want more land. And they’re dragging the world through the mud to get what they want. 

And mainstream media is their evil henchme

Pam Bondi was a terrible person who signed up for a fundamentally dishonest job. But she was blamed by Trump for not winning unwinnable cases on his actions that were grossly unconstitutional. And she wasn’t blamed for burying Epstein Files, but for not burying them well enough.

That’s because national media LOVES Israel and thinks being racist against Arabs and bigoted against Muslims is perfectly normal. They’re not at all offended by that. Mark Levin is over-the-top hateful and no one in media has ever tried to cancel a politician for talking to him.

You notice how mainstream media loves to cancel people based on whether they talked to anyone who criticized Israel too harshly. Isn’t it curious how they never do that to people who associate with @LauraLoomer and @marklevinshow? Those two are biggest racists and bigots in US.

Everyone is excited Pam Bondi is gone and it feels good to have a little accountability. But the next person isn’t going to be any better. They’re going to be picked by Trump, loyal to whatever ludicrous thing Trump wants to do, will bury Epstein files and work for the donors.
